source_notes.event_identity: Joshua’s public LinkedIn post explicitly describes four Swiss AI Futures workshops across Zurich and Lausanne, in German, French and English, involving more than 100 people in an online and in-person process. Project page dates workshops August 11–12, 2026. Individual photos are not assigned to a city.
source_notes.pptx: Self-Introduction.pptx media extracted read-only; slide/media mapping in pptx-slide-media-map.json. No deck photograph selected as Swiss AI Futures or vTaiwan without event attribution.
source_notes.vtaiwan: Downloaded demoinput.jpg and demoinput3.png from info.vtaiwan.tw; inspection showed analysis graphics, not event photos. Do not use their filenames to imply photographs.
source_notes.reuse: Publicly posted project media; photographer/licence not stated in the checked post. Preserve source credit in presentation notes.
source_notes.kultur_komitee: User identified the images as Kultur Komitee fieldwork and requested their inclusion. Photos illustrate the process, not demographic representation, causal effects, or completed project implementation. 2025 deployment figures are sourced separately from the published study.
